summary: Plantera is a Dutch company that breeds, produces and sells seed potatoes and ware potatoes, mainly of its own varieties. It is based in Marknesse, Flevoland, with a breeding farm in Wieringerwerf. It was founded in 2014 by Gerard Bovée and Jeroen van Soesbergen and says it sells about 8,000 tonnes of seed potatoes a year.
products: Seed potatoes of its own varieties
Own varieties for table, chips, fries, peeling and specialty segments
Non-protected varieties (Agria, Charlotte, Désirée, Hermes, Nicola, Spunta)
Variety licences for multiplication and sale abroad
markets: More than 25 countries in Northwest Europe, Southern Europe and North Africa
Dutch-grown seed mostly sold in Europe, North Africa and the Near East
Licence partners in France, Spain, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and South Africa
Licence cultivation also listed in the United States
Segments: fresh export, fresh retail, peeled potatoes and specialty varieties
facts: About 450 ha in total, including 325 ha of seed potato cultivation in the Netherlands
About 8,000 tonnes of seed potatoes and 8,000 tonnes of consumption potatoes per year
Roughly 20% of its cultivation and trade is organic
Plantera Seed BV founded in 2016; Plantera GmbH founded at the end of 2024
limitations: Ownership, turnover and staff numbers are not published on the pages read.
Seed classes, certification and the names of foreign licensees or agents are not published.
Per-variety technical figures such as dry matter and resistance scores were not read, and the year of the stated hectares and tonnes is not given.
